summary: Serves as the root infrastructure package providing foundational modules for archive handling, configuration, CSV data parsing, database persistence, filesystem utilities, domain services, hashing, logging, process execution, and stream processing.
responsibilities: Manage, extract, and define metadata for ZIP archives and entries
Load and manage package configuration settings
Parse, validate, and serialize CSV data using Pydantic models
Manage database connections, exceptions, data mapping, models, repositories, and transactions using SQLAlchemy
Provide filesystem utilities for file I/O, enumeration, search, access checking, and exclusive access handling
Perform business calendar calculations, parameter access, and variable placeholder resolution
Compute standard and truncated SHA-256 hashes for strings, bytes, and files
Provide application-wide logging infrastructure, factories, and instances
Execute external system processes and manage their results and errors
Provide lazy stream processing of Result values and byte stream file writing functions
relationships: Archives use ZIP entries for metadata definition.
CSV readers and writers use configuration options for parsing, encoding, IO, and serialization with Pydantic models.
Repositories and transaction managers utilize database connection and session infrastructure.
File search uses filter conditions, and file operations provide access checking and exclusive access helpers.
Variable translators utilize date and parameter components to resolve placeholders.
The logger factory creates the pre-configured logger instance.
Process execution produces a process result and raises errors upon failures.
design_decisions: Modular organization of infrastructure, utility, and domain service capabilities across specialized packages
Integration with external libraries and standard modules for data validation, ORM persistence, hashing, logging, and process handling
